title: Harry Potter basic
sub: Hedwig's Theme · John Williams · pitches-only sheet
credit: Handwritten pitch-only sheet; rhythm editorial (standard Hedwig's Theme). The sheet is a single treble staff with no key signature, meter or barlines and every note drawn as a plain head with a stem, so the pitches here are measured off the page and the 3/4 dotted-quarter rhythm is supplied from the well-known tune. Melody in the right hand; the left hand rests throughout.
_notation: Per hand, one string per bar. Tokens: pitch (G4, A#4, C5), rest r. Suffix :n = length in eighths (default 1). This song is 3/4: every bar sums to 6 eighths. The sheet gives pitches only; every duration is editorial.

sections.name: Theme
sections.hint: The opening phrase, in A minor: a pickup E, then A-C-B, A up to E, and two held notes, D then B. The second half answers A-C-B with G and A-sharp before landing on a long low E. The sheet gives pitches only, so the dotted-quarter rhythm is editorial; the left hand rests.
sections.coach: Pickup E, then A-C-B. Let the D and the B ring for the whole bar.

sections.name: Second phrase
sections.hint: Same start as the theme, then it climbs: G up top with F-sharp, F with C-sharp, and F-E-D-sharp on the way down through B and C to a held A. Three sharps in a row, each drawn on the sheet. Rhythm editorial.
sections.coach: This is the phrase that climbs. Watch the three sharps: F, C, then D.

sections.name: Theme again
sections.hint: The theme a second time, exactly as the sheet writes it: the only change is bar 22, which starts on G rather than A before the G and A-sharp. Rhythm editorial.
sections.coach: Same as the start. Bar 22 begins on G this time, then G and A-sharp.

sections.name: Second phrase again
sections.hint: The climbing phrase again, but this time the sheet writes no sharps at all: G then F, F then C, and a little turn F-D-E-D before B, C and the held A. Played as drawn. Rhythm editorial.
sections.coach: No sharps this time. The turn in bar 30 goes F, D, E, D.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.hint: Rocking between E and C, up to F-E, then a held D-sharp. B-C, E-D-sharp, and a drop to a low D-sharp and E under the staff before the last phrase. Rhythm editorial.
sections.coach: E and C rock back and forth. The D-sharp in bar 37 is a full bar.

sections.name: Ending
sections.hint: E-C twice, then G with F-sharp and F with C-sharp, and a run down: F-E-D, B-C-A, C up to E and the high B, G-E-C, and a final held A on the double barline. Rhythm editorial.
sections.coach: The last run: F-E-D, B-C-A, up to the high B, then down to A and hold.
